assert subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()==anchor

assert c["startCommit"]==anchor and c["dependencyCommits"]==[anchor] and c["verificationOnly"]
assert c["serverCreatedMetadata"]["model"]=={"id":"gpt-6.1-sol","providerID":"openai","variant":"high"}
prefix="docs/agent/implementation-runs/managed-20261023-integrate-manual-01"
r=json.loads(Path(prefix+".json").read_text()); rows=[]
for ch in r["checks"]:
 p=ch["evidence"]; raw=Path(p).read_bytes(); e=json.loads(raw); out=e.get("output","").encode() if "output" in e else base64.b64decode(e["outputBase64"])
 assert sha(out)==e["outputSha256"] and e["exitCode"]==ch["exitCode"]
 assert raw==subprocess.check_output(["git","show",anchor+":"+p])
 rows.append({"path":p,"sha256":sha(raw),"outputSha256":sha(out),"exitCode":e["exitCode"],"outputTail":out.decode()[-1400:] if "affected-check" in p or "merge.json" in p else "Inspected decoded JSON below"})
identity=json.loads(json.loads(Path(prefix+"/candidate-identity.json").read_text())["output"])
for p,digest in identity["codeInputs"].items(): assert sha(Path(p).read_bytes())==digest,p
assert "sha256:"+sha(json.dumps(identity["codeInputs"],sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode())==r["candidate"]["codeId"]
provenance=json.loads(json.loads(Path(prefix+"/provenance-pass.json").read_text())["output"])
for worker in provenance["workerRecords"]:
 for item in worker["preservedRecords"]+worker["originalChecks"]: assert sha(Path(item["path"] if "path" in item else item["evidence"]).read_bytes())==item["sha256"]
junit=[]
for p,e in json.loads(Path(prefix+"/junit.json").read_text()).items():
 raw=base64.b64decode(e["base64"]); assert sha(raw)==e["sha256"]; root=ET.fromstring(raw); assert root.attrib==e["tests"]
 junit.append({"path":p,"sha256":sha(raw),"attributes":root.attrib,"testNames":[t.attrib["name"] for t in root.findall("testcase")]})
assert sum(int(e["attributes"]["tests"]) for e in junit)==37
controls=["docs/agent/implementation-state.json","docs/agent/implementation-permissions.json","scripts/implementation-loop.py","scripts/implementation-evidence.py","scripts/implementation-resources.py","AGENTS.md"]
print(json.dumps({"inspectedCommit":anchor,"sessionID":c["sessionID"],"model":c["serverCreatedMetadata"]["model"],"lease":"supplied immutable context matches branch/target/model and isolated-host-tests; live lease/session acceptance remains supervisor-owned","originalChecks":rows,"candidateIdentity":identity,"originalJUnit":junit,"preservedWorkerRecords":provenance["workerRecords"],"controlHashes":{p:sha(Path(p).read_bytes()) for p in controls},"apkLimit":"Inspected retained APK assembly/hash evidence only; no APK present or rebuilt in verifier checkout"},indent=2))
